WORDS and MUSIC: Daniel O. Teasley, pub.1907. Public Domain.

There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death. Ec. 8:8 They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave. Job 21:13; Lk. 12:20
